launches.title: Lamin — Open data platform for science
launches.tagline: pip install lamindb to trace, query & govern multimodal data in bio/AI
launches.body:
We’re thrilled to share that Lamin is now generally available! With just a few clicks, anyone can create a database on [lamin.ai](http://lamin.ai).

In 2022, we set out to build an open-source data management tool that’d make it easier to scale AI workflows in the life sciences. Over the past few years, we’ve served research labs and enterprises of all sizes with what used to take a dozen tools:

\- Data lineage\
\- Format-agnostic lakehouse\
\- Notes, ELN, LIMS, ontologies, projects\
\- Versioning + branching\
\- Data lake + catalog\
\- Agents, workflows, notebooks\
\- Feature store, MLOps

With Lamin, it’s just Postgres & storage in a Python package, plus an optional GitHub-like web platform.

Give it a try: pip install lamindb

<https://youtu.be/CFW80-O1YAE>

Repo: <https://github.com/laminlabs/lamindb>

Post: <https://blog.lamin.ai/lamin>
